cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our bookshop failed here. We're meant to find readers somewhere else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we're meant to start smaller. One shelf, properly chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read! I'll pack the short stories. We've been making our customers come too far.

relationship.evidence: B4 solves rather than merely resists the problem in A3.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4 solution into evidence that prior location was wrong.
